combat.name: Palm Vortex
combat.descriptionRaw: Grasping the wind's might, you form a vortex of vacuum in your palm, causing continuous Anemo DMG to opponents in front of you. The vacuum vortex explodes when the skill duration ends, causing a greater amount of Anemo DMG over a larger area. Hold DMG and AoE will gradually increase. Elemental Absorption If the vortex comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type. Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use. You discussed the way to grasp the formless wind with Paimon.

passive.name: Foreign Windwrath
passive.descriptionRaw:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional {LINK#N10050001}<color=#FFD780FF>buffs</color>{/LINK}.

Additionally, when <color=#FF9999FF>Pyro</color>, <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color>, <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color>, or <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> attacks from nearby party members hit opponents, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of the Dawn Breeze. Each Elemental Type can grant 1 Blade of the Dawn Breeze stack. After obtaining at least 2 stacks of Blade of the Dawn Breeze, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of the Dawn Breeze and transform into the special <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</color>
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo DMG</color>. Increase in DMG is equal to 60% of Traveler's ATK.
· Every time a Blade of the Dawn Breeze of a certain elemental type is consumed, a Blade Wind matching this elemental type will also be summoned, dealing elemental DMG equal to 50% of Traveler's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</color> can be triggered up to once every 15s.
· For the duration of <color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack: Whirlwind</color>, no Blade of the Dawn Breeze will be obtained.

combat.name: Ice Fog Piercer
combat.descriptionRaw: Stabs at the opponent with the Traveler's weapon, which releases an ice-cold fog. This deals Cryo DMG to opponents up ahead and forms a Frostpierce Star next to the Traveler. Frostpierce Star · Follows your own party members around the field and periodically fires ice crystals at nearby opponents, dealing Cryo DMG. Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Frostpierce Star will no longer fire ice crystals at opponents at intervals but will instead fire an ice crystal at opponents in a coordinated attack when the Traveler hits an opponent with a Normal Attack, Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s. · When an opponent is hit with an ice crystal, the Traveler gains 1 stack of {LINK#N10050002}Frostglow{/LINK} (max 8 stacks). · When not in combat, Frostglow expires after 30s. You observed the formation of frost together with Paimon.

You felt the keen edge of the icicles alongside Paimon.
